The 2026-10-12 de-duplication gave every block exactly one owner (docs/DUPLICATE-HUBS-FIX.md) and added the check:category-dup gate that fails if it regresses. Re-arm this alert (delete this entry) after Google re-crawls both URLs; a second consecutive snapshot still reporting alternate-canonical would mean the canonical hint needs a stronger fix (301 or a canonical tag on /finance/).
